comment: Website-local: the gate GUARD — the inverse of the authority vector with an identical old-stamped seed. A `journal_role='mirror'` dataset scope belongs to a desktop hub; the cloud must NOT sweep it. Pruning here would raise `pruned_up_to` for journal rows this host does not own and fabricate a spurious `resync_required` for the hub that does. So after the sweep the mark stays 0, no resync is signaled, and the row survives.
